title: Flow r3 - assess the selected target, discover prerequisite needs later
subtitle: Business data flow and key state distinctions; diagram is a target contract, not runtime proof.

nodes.title: 1. Select Role + member Level
fields: Read explicit requiredKnowledgeLevels
Reuse exact official evidence only
Resolve MODULE_ONLY / CERTIFICATE_ONLY

nodes.title: 2. Baseline: separate config
fields: Freeze groups / paper / deadline
Save/resume; automatic timed finalization
Record diagnostics only for groups asked

nodes.title: 3. Request + initial Expert review
fields: A needs learning => A alternatives only
Do not add B from prerequisite edge yet
Request locks BOTH Role and Level

nodes.title: 4. Learn one eligible alternative
fields: Requirement roots branch to choices
Each module retains its own progress
Content alone is not official achievement

nodes.title: 5. Skill assessment: own config
fields: Main + ALL configured prerequisite groups
Per-group pass / mandatory / optional veto
Every retake is a new FULL paper

nodes.title: 6. Discover / record result
fields: Missing B => Cần bổ sung + auto supplement
Official B failure => NEED_REVIEW only
Main waits on required conditions / veto

nodes.title: 7. Complete / bypass-only release
fields: Module + assessment OR approved certificate
Bypass is outstanding, never ACHIEVED
No other mandatory pending work => release

nodes.title: 8. New target + parallel old needs
fields: Carry old bypass context as parallel supplementary learning
Even if new module/certificate arrives: no new-target prerequisite gate
Keep official / diagnostic / waived provenance distinct
